literal: Birth called ignorance to depart, excellence called perfect truth seeing is knowledge.
translation: True knowledge is seeing the perfect truth called excellence, so that the ignorance called birth departs.
modern: பிறப்பு என்னும் அறியாமை நீங்குமாறு சிறப்பு என்னும் உண்மையான பொருளைக் காண்பதே மெய்யறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines true knowledge as the realization of ultimate reality. It contrasts the cycle of birth, which it equates with ignorance, against the supreme excellence of truth. By perceiving this perfect truth, the delusion that causes rebirth is dispelled. The word செம்பொருள் refers to the flawless, ultimate reality that stands in opposition to the transient nature of worldly existence.
